data.name: Bryan
data.gender_notes: Bryan is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bryan derives from the Old Norse name Briani, meaning ‘strong, powerful, honorable.’ In Irish mythology, Brian was a high king of Munster, and in Christian tradition, St. Bryan was a bishop in Armorica. Bryan can also be derived from the Irish name Breannan, meaning ‘handsome, bright, noble.’. The name Bryan carries the meaning “Strong, Honorable” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Bryan usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, honorable and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes strength and courage in the face of adversity.
data.etymology: Bryan belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Strong, Honorable.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bryan total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_hebrew.name: בראיין
in_hebrew.meaning: בנו של אדוני הבית, בראיין הוא שם פרטי לגבר
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם בראיין נגזר משורש עברי שפירושו 'בנו של אדוני הבית' או 'איש בעל הבית'. הוא קשור למושגים של כבוד, נאמנות וקדושה. השם מופיע בתנ"ך כצורה של בר-איון, שפירושו 'בנו של אלוהים' או 'איש אלוהים'. השימוש בשם בראיין נפוץ בקרב הנוצרים כהוקרה לאבות ובני הבית הנוצרים.

in_greek.name: Μπράιαν
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο όρος Μπράιαν προέρχεται από την κελτική λέξη 'brig', που σημαίνει 'ευγενής' ή 'ψηλός', και 'αν', που σημαίνει 'γιος'. Συνεπώς, ο Μπράιαν σημαίνει 'γιος του ευγενή' ή 'ευγενής'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, παρόμοιες ονομασίες συνδέονται με έννοιες τιμής και πνευματικής ευγένειας.

in_latin.name: Bryan
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Bryan derivatur ex origine celtica, quod significat 'filius domini' vel 'nobilis'. In traditione christiana, nomen hoc saepe datus est filiis nobilium familiarum christianarum, significans dignitatem et nobilitatem spiritualem.

in_english.name: Bryan
in_english.long_meaning: The name Bryan originates from the Celtic word 'brig', meaning 'noble' or 'high', and 'an', meaning 'son'. Hence, Bryan signifies 'son of the noble one' or 'strong, honorable man'. Although not directly mentioned in the Bible, similar names convey notions of nobility, spiritual strength, and dignity. Historically, Bryan has been used in Christian traditions to denote respect and virtue.

data.cultural_impact: The name Bryan has been popular in both the English-speaking world and Ireland throughout history, with many notable figures and cultural references. In English-speaking countries, Bryan has been the given name for numerous famous people, including the American singer-songwriter Bryan Adams and the former American football player Brian Urlacher. In Ireland, Bryan Ferry—an English musician—has Celtic roots and there is a town named Bryanstown in County Kerry. These associations reflect the importance and influence of the name throughout history and culture.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Bryan carries deep spiritual significance, originating from the Old Norse name Briani and the Irish name Breannan. Both names evoke powerful and virtuous attributes, symbolizing the strength, power, honesty, nobility, and beauty that radiate from this name. In Christian tradition, St. Bryan serves as a reminder of the power and importance of faith and dedication, inspiring those with the name to live honorably and serves as a source of spiritual comfort and guidance.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Bryan: Strong, honorable, and having a deep sense of the Lord's provision. Derived from the Old English name "Brihtan," meaning "noble one, shining bright." Embracing the light of God, Bryan carries the strength and wisdom of the Lord within.

historical_references.context: Bryan was a powerful king who ruled over the Kingdom of Buda in Hungary during the Middle Ages. He is known for his military prowess and his successful campaigns against invading forces.
